detail.longDescription: My presentation from .NET Conf 2026 is now live on YouTube! 🚀 Stop wrestling with YAML file, see how to write, debug, and run your CI/CD pipelines as strongly typed C# code using Cake 7, the Cake SDK, and .NET 11. Watch here: https:// youtu.be/uszy8DGurcs?si=ZqBSNh 9zrL46nKbQ # dotnet # csharp # devops # dotnetconf
